reference: PROSPECT site (operator-built on spec, docs/LIASSE_DANCE.md Part 13). Engine (booking, accounts, admin) shared with garage-mecanique-el-mirabel; design, content, pages and features are this garage's own.

languages.selection: ?lang= wins, then /en/ path prefix, then the scoped pwa_lang cookie.
languages.content: Bilingual editorial settings are JSON {fr,en} rows in admin_settings; services carry _en columns; text_<key>_<lang> rows override dictionary keys.

features.gabarit: Home + /services/#gabarit: vehicle-size selector (voiture, vus, pickup, gros). services.vehicle_classes (comma list) decides which tire / rust-proofing rows show per size; rows with no classes are general services. Choice remembered in localStorage (mm_gabarit). No-JS = every row visible.
features.voyants: lib/lights.js — 11 dashboard warning lights (stroke SVG pictograms, level stop|soon, meaning, what to do now, linked service). /voyants/ lists them with :target anchors; home shows 6; each service page shows its related lights.
features.booking: 4-step wizard (work → vehicle with VIN decode via NHTSA vPIC → day/time from real availability → sign-in + details). Bay grid (setting bays × slot_minutes), bay_slots PRIMARY KEY (bay, slot_at) is the concurrency guard; idempotent on (user_id, request_key). References MM-XXXXXX. Courtesy car hidden while courtesy_cars=0; towing hidden and refused server-side while towing_offered=0.
features.accounts: Platform visitor auth (services.auth). customer_profiles + vehicles keyed by users.id TEXT. View, reschedule, cancel (until cancel_cutoff_hours), .ics.
features.admin: /admin dashboard (launch checklist), /admin/rendez-vous board, modules services (incl. vehicle_classes), customer_profiles, vehicles, hours, closures, messages; /admin/settings (gates incl. towing_offered, booking rules, texts, privacy).
features.notifications: lib/notify.js — sends ONLY when live_actions_enabled=1 AND appointment.preview=0. crons.js (garage-mm-reminders) sends 24 h reminders under the same rule.
features.seo: Platform-owned: _p_seo_* rows in admin_settings (title/description/keywords fr+en, twitter summary_large_image, locale fr_CA, canonical, og image 1200x630 seo-og-card.jpg + square seo-og-square.jpg — designed cards, AutoRepair JSON-LD with geo, hours, offer catalog incl. oil change min 95 CAD) injected by platformSeoService on every page. Inner pages keep their own <title>/og:title/description (views pass title + metaDescription); service pages emit their own Service JSON-LD. head.ejs: absolute hreflang fr-CA/en-CA/x-default, icons 32/192/180 from the ampersand mark; subscriber_pwas.icon_url = mark 512. Routes: /favicon.ico (302 to mark .ico), /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml (FR+EN pages and services with xhtml alternates). Prospect sites stay noindex (platform X-Robots-Tag) until claimed.
features.embed: ?_embed=1 (homepage showcase capture): the topbar shows « Heures d’ouverture » instead of the live open/closed state, and the hero ticket shows Monday's hours instead of today's.

gates.notes: Phone, address and hours are shown from the public listing; the checklist asks the owner to confirm them. bookings_live requires privacy_approved; while off, appointments are stored with preview=1 and the UI says so.

rules: Brand moments = enamel (navy, ivory, red pinstripe); knowledge = patent plates captioned FIG. nn; flows = shop ticket on paper
The header/footer badge is inline SVG (views/partials/badge.ejs) — never swap it for the raster logo
Drawer lives outside the sticky masthead and parks off-canvas LEFT
Callbar ≤ 72 px so the prospect claim ribbon clears it

assets: lib/assets.js — NEW logo (enamel badge, gpt-image-2.5; the garage had none), app mark (the badge ampersand, edited from the logo), hero + wide + 12 patent-drawing plates (gpt-image-2.5-flare), Cloudinary folder tapavis_tenant_garage_martin_et_martin. Illustrations only, never photographs of the shop.
gaps: NAME TO CONFIRM: Google lists « Garage Martin et Martin »; the garage's own GEM-CAR website brands the same address and phone « Mécanique St-Jérôme ». The site uses Garage Martin & Martin; their transcribed texts had the name swapped accordingly.
The public email (mecaniquestjerome@outlook.com) is shown on the contact page and footer — confirm it is still read.

Only one price was ever published: oil change from 95 $ (taxes extra) — price_verified=1. Every other service shows « Sur estimation » until the owner prices it; their GEM-CAR price list showed tire and rust-proofing rows by vehicle size without amounts.
Their price list names no rust-proofing row for a regular pick-up — the gabarit selector shows only the tire rows for that size, plus a call prompt when a size has nothing.
Inspection sécuritaire: nothing says whether this is a SAAQ-accredited inspection; the page describes a general safety check.
Service durations are planning estimates (edit in admin/services). Number of service bays unknown — default 2.
Service area « Mirabel, Saint-Jérôme et les environs » is inferred from the address and the St-Jérôme trade name.
No courtesy car and no towing were ever advertised — both are off (courtesy_cars=0, towing_offered=0).
No statutory holidays seeded as closures — the owner adds them.
Privacy notice is a Law 25 DRAFT with the responsible person's name to complete.
No photographs of the shop or team were available (Google listing has none); none are shown. Google shows 4.8★ on 89 reviews — not displayed, no review text is reproduced.
Warning-light guide is general driver guidance; the page tells visitors the vehicle manual is the reference.
